intro: Metrics mode: Steward reads Gatus' Prometheus endpoint (metrics: true in the Gatus configuration) on an interval and keeps its own history: uptime per endpoint, response times, outages and certificate expiry – for monitors, reports and the credentials register.
securityText: Anyone who can reach Gatus can read it. Restrict it in the network: a reverse proxy that lets only Steward's host through, or a Gatus that is only reachable from Steward.
metricsPathHint: Below the base URL of the platform
fetchUptimesHint: Once an hour per endpoint from /api/v1/endpoints/{key}/uptimes/… (unauthenticated in Gatus).
removeConfirm: Turn metrics mode off and delete all samples of this platform?
